## Checklist

- [ ] Every new or changed fact cites an official Salesforce Personalization, Salesforce Interactions SDK (Data 360) or Data 360 source as `[src](url)`. Workshop and third-party sources are labeled `(workshop source)` or `(third-party)` and are secondary.
- [ ] Nothing describes Marketing Cloud Personalization (MCP) as if it were Salesforce Personalization; MCP pages are cited only to explain differences.
- [ ] Labels are used as defined in `CONTRIBUTING.md`: `(UNVERIFIED)`, `(Field-observed, undocumented)`, `(Field-verified)`, `(inference)`, `(workshop source)`, `(third-party)`, `(verbatim)`. SQL is tagged `field-verified`, `doc-derived (untested)` or `doc sample (verbatim)`.
- [ ] No customer or project names, org identifiers, tenant hosts, record IDs, credentials, email addresses, internal conversations or roadmap statements.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_skill.py --strict` passes locally.
- [ ] Reviewer-checked rules (source accuracy, label use, terminology) were read, because the validator can't check them.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `Unreleased`.
